details.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): The sense and Malaysian answer are correct. Indonesian “mertua laki-laki” is interpretable but is not the safest common learner form; “bapak mertua” or “ayah mertua” is more natural. The relation is otherwise valid, and no false-friend contrast is required. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
